name: ModifyStrategy

parameters.help_en: The source IP address of the request
parameters.name: source_ip

parameters.help_en:
The new interval of the baseline check. Valid values:

1: every 2 days
3: every 4 days
7: every 8 days
30: every 31 days
parameters.help_zh:
修改基线检查的周期。取值：

1：每隔1天。
3：每隔3天。
7：每隔7天。
30：每隔30天
parameters.name: cycle_days

parameters.help_en: The new name of the baseline check policy
parameters.help_zh: 修改基线检查策略的名称
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en:
The new time range during which the baseline check starts. Valid values:

0: The baseline check starts within the time range from 00:00 to 06:00.
6: The baseline check starts within the time range from 06:00 to 12:00.
12: The baseline check starts within the time range from 12:00 to 18:00.
18: The baseline check starts within the time range from 18:00 to 24:00.

This parameter is deprecated
parameters.help_zh:
修改基线检查开始的时间。取值：

0：表示基线检查开始时间为0:00~6:00。
6：表示基线检查开始时间为6:00~12:00。
12：表示基线检查开始时间为12:00~18:00。
18：表示基线检查开始时间为18:00~24:00。

此参数作废
parameters.name: cycle_start_time

parameters.help_en: The subtype of the baselines. You can call the [DescribeRiskType](~~DescribeRiskType~~) operation to query the subtypes of baselines
parameters.help_zh: 查询[DescribeRiskType](~~DescribeRiskType~~)接口获取检测项子类型
parameters.name: risk_sub_type_name

parameters.help_en: The ID of the baseline check policy
parameters.name: id

parameters.help_en:
The custom configurations of the baseline. The value of this parameter is in the JSON format and contains the following fields:

typeName: the name of the baseline.

checkDetails: the details of the baseline. The value is in the JSON format.

    *   checkId: the ID of the check item.

    *   rules: the rule configurations. The value is in the JSON format.

        *   ruleId: the ID of the rule.

        *   paramList: the list of parameters in the rule. The value is in the JSON format.

            *   paramName: the name of the parameter.
            *   value: the value of the parameter
parameters.help_zh:
支持自定义基线检查项配置。该值为JSON格式，包含以下参数：

typeName：基线名称。
checkDetails：检测详情，该值为JSON格式。

    - checkId：检测项编号。
    - rules：策略配置，该值为JSON格式。

        - ruleId：策略配置编号。
        - paramList：策略参数配置集合，该值为JSON格式。

            - paramName：参数名称。
            - value：参数配置值
parameters.name: risk_custom_params

parameters.help_en:
The type of the baseline check policy. Valid values:

custom: a custom baseline check policy
common: a standard baseline check policy
parameters.help_zh:
策略类型。取值：

custom：自定义策略。
common：标准策略
parameters.name: custom_type

parameters.help_en:
The method that is used to apply the baseline check policy. Valid values:

groupId: asset groups
uuid: assets
parameters.help_zh:
策略扫描方式。取值：

groupId：群组扫描。
uuid：资产扫描
parameters.name: target_type

parameters.help_en: The time when the baseline check based on the baseline check policy starts. Specify the time in the hh:mm:ss format
parameters.help_zh: 策略执行开始的时间。格式为hh:mm:ss
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The time when the baseline check based on the baseline check policy ends. Specify the time in the hh:mm:ss format
parameters.help_zh: 策略执行结束时间。格式为hh:mm:ss
parameters.name: end_time
